sources.snippet: This is the active development version of the Echo agent project — a lightweight, local LLM agent tool system written in Rust. I use a custom model Echo Instroder 14B that has been trained using QLoRA as a merged base. It is trained specifically to use this framework. It is a continuation of the earlier Echo Adapt_v3 and adds support for proxy-style tool calls, opt in opt out output ...
